name: Agent Evals tab shows the seeded eval case and the four metric tiles
description: Agents list -> Eval Demo Reviewer (seeded by server/src/db/seed-evals.ts) -> Evals tab. Waits for the seeded must_find case name and the tile labels that only render once a completed run exists. 'Recall' and 'Precision' also head runs-table columns, so the flow additionally waits on 'Citation accuracy' and 'Traces passed' (unique to the tiles). No run control is clicked, so no request starts a run and no model is called. Read-only; but flow 17 adds a third case, so this flow must stay ordered before it.
